optimizer.name: scipy.optimize.minimize(Nelder-Mead)
optimizer.initial_simplex: SciPy default 5 percent coordinate perturbation; zero coordinate becomes .00025

configuration.endpoint_selection: Best finite training objective completed by the deadline; independent evaluation never selects endpoint
configuration.late_call: Whole cost retained; candidate finishing after the deadline excluded

score.scope: precision flag retained at cap, no selection of endpoints by scores

configuration.comparison_scope: CPU custom optimizer; JAX IF2/IFAD reference is not a same-hardware speed ranking

median_scope: Includes all endpoint estimates, including insufficient score precision; not a precision-qualified method ranking
interpretation: CPU native PF + external Nelder-Mead; fixed-time search, not a convergence certificate. Do not pool these CPU costs with GPU IF2/IFAD as a hardware speed ranking.

random_stream_audit.interpretation: Scoring is separate from training. Across packages, matching start/rep/batch intentionally uses the same scoring seed; package scores are not mutually independent.
random_stream_audit.scope: All currently saved completed endpoints from each package
